name: moneypal
description: Helps people review and maintain their local Beancount ledgers through MoneyPal.

displayDescription.zh: 全自动记账，账单一键导入，收支自动归类，余额报表一目了然；每笔记账先预览再确认，省心又安心。
displayDescription.en: Fully automatic bookkeeping — no more manual entry, one by one! Import bills with a single click, auto-categorize income and spending, and review balances and reports at a glance. Every entry is previewed before it's written, so it's effortless and reliable.
